dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, closed-loop ovoids with crenulated perimeters; prominent structures include a large dorsal ring with a high-gradient transition from dark exterior to white interior and a distinct 'C' shaped structure located in the mid-posterior lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of bright pixel clusters in the anterior region where rings coalesce into solid patches; mid-section shows lower density with distinct separation between ring centroids.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationships between the three largest dorsal rings form an obtuse triangle; the distance between the two most anterior centroids is roughly half the distance to the primary posterior ring centroid.

other_distinctive_markers: Complex interlocking catenary pattern of light-colored rings across the lateral-posterior region, creating a mesh-like visual texture.
